svg.title: KORA Roasters — Customer & Admin UX Flow Diagram (v1)
svg.desc: Self-contained UX architecture diagram mapping the KORA Roasters Customer Flow (Home to Pending Confirmation) and Admin Flow (Sign-in, Orders Dashboard, Product Management) with edge states in #2C211E and neutral grays on a transparent canvas.

g.font-family: 'Avenir Next', Futura, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif
g.text: Customer Request-Only Flow (No Instant Checkout) & Admin Management

g.font-family: 'Avenir Next', Futura, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif
g.text: 01 / CUSTOMER FLOW: HOME → SHOP → PRODUCT DETAIL → CART → ORDER REQUEST → PENDING CONFIRMATION
STATE: INSUFFICIENT OR LOW STOCK (SHOP & PRODUCT)
• Low Stock (1–5 units): Shows "Low Stock (X left)" badge; caps qty at X.
• Out of Stock (0 units): Shows "Out of Stock" badge; disables [Add to Cart].
• Cart Cap: Requesting > available stock shows notice & caps at max stock.
Rule: Validated in Cart/Request; deducted only when Admin approves.

g.font-family: 'Avenir Next', Futura, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif
g.text: 02 / ADMIN FLOW: ADMIN SIGN-IN → ORDERS DASHBOARD → REVIEW REQUEST & UPDATE STATUS ↔ PRODUCT MANAGEMENT
• Line items requested vs. current SKU stock
• Product list: Name, Roast, Weight (250g), Price
• Add / Edit Product form (Single SKU model)
• Shown when no order requests exist
• Pending → Approved: Deducts requested qty from stock.
• Insufficient Stock Guard: Blocks "Approved" if current
SKU stock < requested qty (prompts stock edit or Decline).
• Flags SKUs with Stock ≤ 5 (Low) or 0 (Out of Stock).
• Invalid Product Form: Requires Name, Price > 0, Weight,
Roast Profile, and non-negative integer Stock (≥ 0).
• Updates immediately sync to Customer Shop & Cart caps.
